Unfortunately, this will not be possible until the unit is fully managed by fäm Living.

Please rest assured that all the existing amenities and facilities of the apartment will remain the same. The apartment owner is also aware of this arrangement.

This is also why we always recommend and confirm bookings after guests have completed a self-viewing, so they can see and feel comfortable with the apartment before confirming their stay.

We truly appreciate your understanding and hope this clarifies the situation.
